# 74138 - 3-line to 8-line decoder/demultiplexer

Package DIP-16 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74138.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74138.json)

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 15 | Y0 = NOT(G1 AND G2A' AND G2B' AND C' AND B' AND A') | Y0 is low when G1 is high, G2A and G2B are low and C,B,A = 0; high otherwise. |
| 14 | Y1 = NOT(G1 AND G2A' AND G2B' AND C' AND B' AND A) | Y1 is low when G1 is high, G2A and G2B are low and C,B,A = 1; high otherwise. |
| 13 | Y2 = NOT(G1 AND G2A' AND G2B' AND C' AND B AND A') | Y2 is low when G1 is high, G2A and G2B are low and C,B,A = 2; high otherwise. |
| 12 | Y3 = NOT(G1 AND G2A' AND G2B' AND C' AND B AND A) | Y3 is low when G1 is high, G2A and G2B are low and C,B,A = 3; high otherwise. |
| 11 | Y4 = NOT(G1 AND G2A' AND G2B' AND C AND B' AND A') | Y4 is low when G1 is high, G2A and G2B are low and C,B,A = 4; high otherwise. |
| 10 | Y5 = NOT(G1 AND G2A' AND G2B' AND C AND B' AND A) | Y5 is low when G1 is high, G2A and G2B are low and C,B,A = 5; high otherwise. |
| 9 | Y6 = NOT(G1 AND G2A' AND G2B' AND C AND B AND A') | Y6 is low when G1 is high, G2A and G2B are low and C,B,A = 6; high otherwise. |
| 7 | Y7 = NOT(G1 AND G2A' AND G2B' AND C AND B AND A) | Y7 is low when G1 is high, G2A and G2B are low and C,B,A = 7; high otherwise. |

## Not known

- The datasheet does not say which input-to-output paths have 2 and which have 3 levels of delay.

## Notes

Timing is the SN74LS138 table (page 4). SN74S138A (page 6, RL 280 ohm, CL 15 pF): select 2 levels tPLH 4.5/7, tPHL 7/10.5; 3 levels tPLH 7.5/12, tPHL 8/12; enable 2 levels tPLH 5/8, tPHL 7/11; 3 levels tPLH 7/11, tPHL 7/11 ns typ/max. Plain file: the lookup uses it for 74LS138 and 74S138.
